question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f0b277f3cf374d9da113808df8963ad373578b859933eb01b707eb0f53a278a.png] 

The logic followed here is: Logic: In each pair, the second letter-cluster is obtained by subtracting 2 from the positional values of the letters of the first letter-cluster (Cluster 1 Letter - 2 = Cluster 2 Letter).
